diagnostics.message: google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service has no ordering dependency on google_project_service.project_services. When compute.googleapis.com is enabled here, the Shared VPC attachment can race Compute API activation (and API deactivation can precede attachment deletion). Wait for the managed API services, as the host-project resource already does.

google_logging_project_exclusion.logging-exclusion uses the Logging API but does not wait for google_project_service.project_services. When logging.googleapis.com is managed here, exclusion operations can race its activation or deactivation. Establish API-service ordering, as already done for the logging sinks.

output.id already depends on data.google_project.project through google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_identity_cmek. Its direct depends_on entry for the project data source is redundant.

google_org_policy_policy.default has no ordering dependency on google_project_service.project_services. If this module enables orgpolicy.googleapis.com, policy creation can run before that activation completes. Order the policy resource after the managed API services; the project reference alone does not express API readiness.

google_essential_contacts_contact.contact does not wait for google_project_service.project_services. When essentialcontacts.googleapis.com is enabled here for the API consumer project, contact creation can race service activation. Add ordering on the managed API services; this does not replace the separate billing_project/user_project_override requirements documented for user ADCs.

google_monitoring_monitored_project.primary has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. When monitoring.googleapis.com activation for the monitored project is managed here, adding the project to a metrics scope can race API enablement. Wait for the managed services before creating the monitoring association.
